Third-party software: AsmJit
============================

AsmJit is third-party code written by Petr Kobalicek and contributors. It is
not pyrlyn-jit code.

Source:  https://github.com/asmjit/asmjit
Pinned:  commit 0464e1c (2026-10-16)
Local:   third_party/asmjit (a local git clone, gitignored, not committed to this
         repository and not distributed with pyrlyn-jit)
License: Zlib (third_party/asmjit/LICENSE.md, reproduced below)

How AsmJit is used
------------------
1. Tests only, not part of the product. The AsmJit source code is never compiled
   into or distributed with libpyrlyn-jit. It is used for:
   - src/asmjit_x64_tests.zig, src/asmjit_x86_tests.zig, src/asmjit_a64_tests.zig:
     expected bytes ported from AsmJit's assembler tests (enabled with
     -Dasmjit-tests; scripts/gen_asmjit_tests.py, scripts/gen_asmjit_a64_tests.py)
   - bench/ref/asmjit_*.bin: reference machine code produced by AsmJit for the
     benchmark scenarios (bench/asmjit_bench.cpp)

2. Encoder tables generated from AsmJit's instruction database. These ARE compiled
   into libpyrlyn-jit:
   - src/x86_64/gp_table.zig   (scripts/gen_gp_tables.py,  db/isa_x86.json)
   - src/x86_64/vec_table.zig  (scripts/gen_vec_tables.py, db/isa_x86.json and
                                asmjit/x86/x86_inst_db.cpp)
   - src/aarch64/a64_table.zig (scripts/gen_a64_tables.py, db/isa_aarch64.json)
   - src/x86_64/isa.zig, src/aarch64/isa.zig
                               (scripts/gen_isa_tables.py, db/isa_*.json)
   They are altered (machine-generated) derivatives of AsmJit's database and
   carry a header line pointing to this file. The Zlib notice below applies
   to them.

Updating
--------
The pin is not updated routinely. To regenerate:
    git clone https://github.com/asmjit/asmjit third_party/asmjit
    git -C third_party/asmjit checkout 0464e1c   # or a newer commit
    python3 scripts/gen_gp_tables.py
    python3 scripts/gen_vec_tables.py
    python3 scripts/gen_a64_tables.py
    python3 scripts/gen_isa_tables.py
    zig build test -Dasmjit-tests=true
If the pin changes, update this file and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.
